}}'''Eurian Romavni''' is a Kandorian author.

==Activities==
He wrote ''[[A Journey to Tarabon]]'' fifty-three years ago. [[Egwene]] uses the information on the book to help her scout the city of [[Tanchico]] and the Panarch Palace in ''[[tel'aran'rhiod]]''.{{ref/book|4|11}}
